text_conditions: complete CLIP/T5; audit lengths and cache identity before each stage
exposure: Existing benchmark with past project exposure; not claimed genuinely unseen data

adaptive_source_lift.selection: first source-cycle pass at fixed horizon; no target score used

statistics.unit: source image; seeds/targets within a source are not independent units
statistics.primary_metric: joint full task completion and no major unrequested change/artifact
statistics.rejected_and_unassessable_cases: count as non-success in primary coverage denominator
statistics.equal_completion_subset: secondary only; report subset size and full-case outcomes

annotation.before_generation: freeze per-pair allowed/protected factors and task rubric
annotation.category_morphology: allow target-appropriate morphology; do not equate it with pose drift
annotation.scorer: existing SigLIP2 offline; record absolute target/source logits separately

stage_gates.smoke: identity/pair accounting pass; retain rejected high-horizon candidates as failures
stage_gates.mechanism: reference numerically stable or mark reference_unresolved
stage_gates.confirmation: Consume the four explicit development_main jobs at T=.9; require >=2/4 full target completions, >=3/4 source gate coverage, completed map-stability audit for every accepted development case, and code/config/annotations locked. Otherwise stop before confirmation.
stage_gates.quality_claim: joint success and protected-factor outcomes at comparable full completion; source PSNR alone is insufficient
stage_gates.main_map_stability: Compare fixed-qT source and target maps at 24/48/96 steps; require each successive difference <=5e-4 RMS or mark solver_consistency_failed. Do not silently change the main solver.

costs: Transformer calls below exclude text/VAE and any offline derivative probes; report all actual calls/time
optional_extension: 1024 resolution and genuinely new independent sources only after primary gates pass
reviewed_method_role: approximate partial-inversion diagnostic; no proven inversion-free preservation gain
machine_source_cycle_guarantee: correction amplitude only; edit reference error additionally requires conditioning
solver_audit: On accepted development lifts, compare source and target Heun24/48/96 maps; numerical grid stability is not a rigorous error certificate
